title: Moroccan Brie Tartine with Amlou
description: A simple yet elegant appetizer featuring creamy brie cheese, crunchy understated bread, and a rich moroccan amlou spread. Perfect for a warm evening gathering.

ingredients.name: brie cheese
ingredients.notes: look for a high-quality, creamy brie

ingredients.name: amlou
ingredients.notes: mixture of almonds, honey, and rose water

instructions: 2. Toast the baguette slices until lightly browned.
3. Spread a layer of amlou on each toasted bread slice.
4. Top the amlou with a slice of softened brie cheese.
5. Sprinkle chopped rosemary over the cheese.
6. Drizzle with olive oil and a pinch of salt.
7. Bake in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
8. Remove from oven and drizzle with honey.
